name: Heat equation
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      The <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heat_equation">heat equation</a>, also known as the diffusion equation, describes multiple phenomena including the spreading-out of heat in a solid body and the diffusion of chemicals in a liquid.
    </description>
    <rule name="Heat equation" type="formula" wrap="0" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.0025
      </param>
      <param name="a_clamp_min">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="a_clamp_max">
        100
      </param>
      <param name="diffusion_rate">
        5
      </param>
      <param name="boil_rate">
        0.018
      </param>
      <param name="boil_history_rate">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="boil_diffusion_rate">
        7
      </param>
      <param name="boil_threshold">
        0.95
      </param>
      <param name="boil_heat_loss">
        1211
      </param>
      <param name="boil_power">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_b">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="boil_to_b">
        222
      </param>
      <param name="b_damp">
        1.3
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        58
      </param>
      <param name="b_pow">
        1.1
      </param>
      <param name="b_pow_norm">
        0.95
      </param>
      <param name="b_clamp_min">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="b_clamp_max">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
                                        a = clamp( sign(a) * pow( fabs( a + boil_rate ), (float4) power ), (float4) a_clamp_min, (float4) a_clamp_max);
float4 boil = pow( clamp( (float4) ( ((a+laplacian_a * boil_diffusion_rate) - boil_threshold ) * boil_heat_loss ), (float4) 0.0, (float4) 1.0 ), (float4)boil_power );
a = a + ( -a * boil - a * b * boil_history_rate );
delta_a = laplacian_a * diffusion_rate;
delta_b = -b*b_damp + a*a_to_b + boil*boil_to_b + D_b * laplacian_b;
b = clamp( sign(b) * pow( (float4)( fabs(b)/b_pow_norm ), (float4)b_pow )*b_pow_norm, b_clamp_min, b_clamp_max );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
